Ledger Entry 3 — Pot-84 belongs to Flue Core.
Ledger Entry 4 — For Pot-22, the damper bar is released.
Ledger Entry 5 — Pot-62 passed thermocouple bridge check.
Ledger Entry 6 — Pot-41 verified flue draft balance.

Fallback Policy: Pot-22 is under active default status, so Pot-22 is assigned to Bay-Glaze unless the rules establish that Pot-22 opens annealing priority.

Active Protocols:
Protocol 1 — Whenever Pot-22 signaled a cone sag, certify that Pot-22 enters reduction soak.

Protocol 6 — Whenever Pot-22 carries a glaze viscosity card and Pot-22 carries an emergency board waiver, override the fallback outcome and place Pot-22 under Bay-Bisque.
Protocol 7 — If Pot-62 passed thermocouple bridge check and Pot-41 verified flue draft balance, record a routine audit note for Pot-62.
Protocol 8 — Whenever Pot-84 signaled a cone sag, certify that Pot-84 is placed on a standby list.

Question: Based strictly on the ledger entries and active protocols above, what is the assigned outcome for Pot-22?
Options:
A. Bay-Bisque
B. Bay-Frit
C. Bay-Slip
D. Bay-Glaze
